verdict.rationale: Devin publishes its own API reference: an api-reference/overview page and an llms.txt index listing a large API section. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and the probe found no public OpenAPI spec at the standard paths. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground, runnable code examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.
